**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wchill/revanced-patches/compare/v5.18.1...v5.34.1

See https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/releases for official changelog.

Unofficial patch changelog:

* Merged official patches up to 5.34.0 (7bb1fbb433e8347f42682e743820c6c146e8d554)
* Modified Arctic Shift API call to only pull up to 25k comments at a time, due to a new API limit (3aa2996da5d372eae77e932469b388df4a337602)
* Fix a bug where comments on still-active posts weren't restored (464ab5a5a3b4b04c949b2459e606d8417439a03b)
